verseText: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
meaning: Keeping our minds 'stayed' on God means to keep our thoughts focused on who he is, what he's done, and what he wants us to do. When we do this, we can enjoy peace, even in times of trouble.
